mixerTooltip: Monitor audio levels. If the bars are moving you are outputting audio.
loudnessHidden: You can show the loudness panel again under Settings → General.
loudnessTooltip: Perceived loudness of the stream audio (last 3 seconds, EBU R 128). Use the menu to change the target.
gainBadgeTooltip: A gain filter raises the volume by {db} dB. Click to change it. If it is too loud, lower it with the mixer volume.
gainUpTooltip: If it is still too quiet at maximum volume, a gain filter raises it to {db} dB. If it becomes too loud, lower it with the mixer volume.
gainMaxTooltip: Maximum reached. To go louder, raise the input volume in Windows sound settings
